body: Last week nine IPOs aimed to raise ₹10,506 crore. The largest was Zetwerk Manufacturing at ₹5,012 crore (₹143–151 a share), followed by Bonfiglioli Transmissions at ₹2,534 crore and defence-tech firm Tonbo Imaging at ₹852 crore.
HD Fire Protect, Fusion CX and Sahajanand Medical Technologies also opened mainboard issues, alongside three SME listings.
dek: Nine issues hit the market last week, from a ₹5,012 crore Zetwerk offer to small SME listings.
title: Zetwerk leads a ₹10,500 crore IPO week
why: With Jio Platforms following straight after, October is shaping up as one of the busiest months for new listings, a sign companies see strong demand from investors.
